endorsements.name: Takahiro Haruyama
endorsements.label: Malicious File for Exploiting Forensic Software
endorsements.description: Commercial forensic software such as EnCase, FTK and X-Ways Forensics adopts the same library component for viewing file content. If the library component is exploitable, lots of forensic investigators are exposed to risks like malware infection and freeze of the software by checking crafted malicious files.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2013

evidence-links.title: Black Hat USA 2013 - Malicious File for Exploiting Forensic Software

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
